title: Countershape CandidateOutcomeMap v1
description: A phase-scoped, admitted candidate roster represented by the complete sorted eligible candidate-to-projection map plus explicit exclusions. artifact_digest identifies the whole wire artifact; preservation_map_digest is only the derived digest of the complete eligible labeled map. Preservation still requires a separate comparability decision before digest equality may be interpreted. Constructor semantics require globally unique world-instance and attempt-artifact evidence across every contributing candidate batch.

preservation_map_digest.description: Derived digest of the complete sorted eligible candidate_execution_key to projection_fingerprint map. This digest alone never proves comparability or preservation.

comparison_admission_digests.description: Exact ordered per-repetition admission-matrix digest set shared by every contributing candidate batch. The semantic constructor rejects any candidate batch with a different set.

comparison_basis_digest.description: Stimulus- and purpose-independent plan/envelope/roster/equality-basis identity used by preservation comparability. It is distinct from the per-run comparison admission artifact digest.

world_instance_digests.description: Union of world-instance identities from all contributing batches. Semantic construction requires this list to be complete as well as unique.

attempt_artifact_digests.description: Union of attempt-artifact identities from all contributing batches. Semantic construction requires this list to be complete as well as unique.

duplicate_evidence_across_candidates.description: False asserts identity-level nonduplication across the contributing batches, not physical execution freshness or host isolation.
